topic: Filing Complaints on Behalf of Consumers
questionText: Who can file a consumer complaint before a Consumer Commission besides the individual consumer?

options.text: Any unregistered private individual or social media group representing consumer awareness
options.mistakeAnalysis: Incorrect option. Inverts the governing property or boundary condition.

options.text: Only legal practitioners holding accreditation from international trade tribunals
options.mistakeAnalysis: Incorrect option. Applies an adjacent or reciprocal mathematical relation.

options.text: Only the manufacturer or primary seller of the product subject to the legal dispute
options.mistakeAnalysis: Incorrect option. Confuses related NCERT concepts or attributes.

options.text: Any registered Voluntary Consumer Association, the Central or State Government, or the CCPA
options.mistakeAnalysis: Correct answer. Accurately identifies the verified NCERT principle for Filing Complaints on Behalf of Consumers.

detailedSolution:
Detailed Solution:
According to NCERT principles for Resource Management (Filing Complaints on Behalf of Consumers):
Any registered Voluntary Consumer Association, the Central or State Government, or the CCPA

Detailed Analysis:
Under Section 35 of the Consumer Protection Act, 2019, a complaint may be filed by an individual consumer, any registered Voluntary Consumer Association, the Central or State Government, one or more consumers having the same interest, or the Central Consumer Protection Authority (CCPA). Distractors A, B, and D are plausible in style but legally incorrect.

Therefore, option (D) is the correct answer.
